name: get_vercel_ci_task_run_logs
description:
Get log lines for one task run attempt of a Vercel CI job run. Optionally filter by log level or since. With follow=1, the call waits until the task run finishes or the stream reaches its maximum duration, then returns the collected log lines.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/vercel-ci/invocations/{invocationId}/attempts/{attempt}/job-definitions/{jobDefinitionId}/runs/{runAttempt}/task-definitions/{taskDefinitionId}/runs/{taskRunAttempt}/logs --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

follow.description: When 1, stream log lines as newline-delimited JSON until the task run finishes.

level.description: Only return log lines with one of these levels.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
